mapper.sql: SELECT k.user_id, s.pet_name, s.pet_type, s.breed_name FROM ( SELECT po.user_id, po.id AS order_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY po.user_id ORDER BY po.created_at DESC, po.id DESC) AS rn FROM pet_order po WHERE po.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND po.store_id = #{storeId} ) k JOIN order_pet_snapshot s ON s.order_id = k.order_id WHERE k.rn = 1

SELECT o.user_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(GREATEST(o.pay_amount - o.refunded_amount, 0)) AS total_spend, MAX(o.verified_at) AS last_visit_at FROM pet_order o WHERE o.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND o.store_id = #{storeId} GROUP BY o.user_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM pet_order WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND store_id = #{storeId}

SELECT o.user_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(GREATEST(o.pay_amount - o.refunded_amount, 0)) AS total_spend, MAX(o.verified_at) AS last_visit_at, latest.pet_name AS top_pet_name, latest.pet_type AS top_pet_type, latest.breed_name AS top_breed_name FROM pet_order o LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.pet_name, s.pet_type, s.breed_name FROM order_pet_snapshot s JOIN pet_order po ON po.id = s.order_id WHERE po.user_id = #{userId} AND po.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND po.store_id = #{storeId} ORDER BY po.created_at DESC, po.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest ON TRUE WHERE o.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND o.store_id = #{storeId} AND o.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY o.user_id, latest.pet_name, latest.pet_type, latest.breed_name

SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(o.paid_at IS NOT NULL) AS paid_order_count, SUM(o.verified_at IS NOT NULL) AS verified_order_count, SUM(o.refunded_amount > 0) AS refund_order_count, SUM(o.order_stage = 'CANCELED' AND o.cancel_reason = 'MERCHANT_REJECT_ORDER') AS reject_order_count, SUM(GREATEST(o.pay_amount - o.refunded_amount, 0)) AS revenue FROM pet_order o WHERE o.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND o.store_id = #{storeId} AND o.created_at >= #{from} AND o.created_at < #{to}

SELECT t.service_id, latest.service_name, t.order_count, t.revenue FROM ( SELECT o.service_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(GREATEST(o.pay_amount - o.refunded_amount, 0)) AS revenue FROM pet_order o WHERE o.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND o.store_id = #{storeId} AND o.created_at >= #{from} AND o.created_at < #{to} GROUP BY o.service_id ORDER BY order_count DESC, service_id ASC LIMIT #{limit} ) t LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.service_id, MAX(s.service_name) AS service_name FROM order_service_snapshot s JOIN pet_order po ON po.id = s.order_id WHERE po.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND po.store_id = #{storeId} AND s.created_at = ( SELECT MAX(s2.created_at) FROM order_service_snapshot s2 JOIN pet_order po2 ON po2.id = s2.order_id WHERE s2.service_id = s.service_id AND po2.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND po2.store_id = #{storeId}) GROUP BY s.service_id ) latest ON latest.service_id = t.service_id ORDER BY t.order_count DESC, t.service_id ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS bucket_date, SUM(GREATEST(o.pay_amount - o.refunded_amount, 0)) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM pet_order o WHERE o.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND o.store_id = #{storeId} AND o.created_at >= #{from} AND o.created_at < #{to} GROUP BY bucket_date ORDER BY bucket_date ASC

SELECT t.user_id, t.order_count, t.total_spend, t.last_visit_at, p.pet_name AS top_pet_name, p.pet_type AS top_pet_type, p.breed_name AS top_breed_name FROM ( SELECT o.user_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(GREATEST(o.pay_amount - o.refunded_amount, 0)) AS total_spend, MAX(o.verified_at) AS last_visit_at FROM pet_order o WHERE o.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND o.store_id = #{storeId} AND o.user_id IN () GROUP BY o.user_id ORDER BY total_spend DESC, user_id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset} ) t LEFT JOIN (
) p ON p.user_id = t.user_id ORDER BY t.total_spend DESC, t.user_id ASC
